scenario: Underscore beside a hex prefix, per [LLEX.11.1]: `0x_FF` is invalid. `HEX_LIT ::= '0x' HEX_DIGIT ('_'? HEX_DIGIT)*` puts a hex digit, never a `_`, right after `0x`, so `0x_FF` does not lex as a HEX_LIT.
rules_ds:
schema S scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    S s where s.v == 0x_FF
->
    log info "x"
